detail:
verdict=deploy-ready; posted and transitioned; caveats:
  - Only the admin REST endpoint was exercised; there is no user-facing UI route for GET /api/admin/observations/patient/{pmrn}/ that was driven end to end.
  - The pre-fix class used for the red check was recompiled with @Slf4j stripped (the class contains no log usage) rather than being extracted from a pre-fix image build.
  - Tenants exercised were demo-demo (full positive/negative) and mayo-mayo (404 only); no MGB tenant was touched.
  - The sibling endpoints on ObservationController (addObservation, delete paths) were only exercised incidentally during setup, not re-validated after the class restore.
